actions.title: GLPI backup, recovery, and independent validation
actions.summary: Close the remaining continuity gap for the interim bare-metal GLPI service by proving that another SOTE Operator can recover the service from documented procedures without relying on the original builder's memory. This is not a new GLPI deployment mission. It is bounded closeout work required by the SOTE Definition of Operational and by the completion criteria already established in #40.
actions.completion_rule: This work item may close when another authorized Operator can locate the documentation, locate the approved backup, execute the documented recovery process, and demonstrate a functioning recovered service without depending on the original builder standing beside them. > A backup that has never been restored is a hope, not a recovery plan.
